title: Trunk Recorder Pro interface protocol
description: The JSON messages on the WebSocket /api/ws. FromRecorder: server → client; ToRecorder: client → server. Generated from web/src/protocol.ts — see docs/api/README.md.

CallEntry.description: A recorded call: `path` (no extension) under the capture folder.

call_num.description: The call's number since the recorder started.

talkgroup_group_tag.description: The talkgroup file's Tag and Category columns.

freq_error.description: How far off its channel the voice was, Hz (0: not measured).

priority.description: Its P25 priority and service-option mode bit.

tone_mode.description: Conventional analog: the tone it was matched on ("ctcss" / "dcs"), "search" (identified, not required), else "off".

signal.description: Reception: the channel's level and the noise under it (dBFS), their difference (dB), and the share of voice frames decoded cleanly (digital).

patched_talkgroups.description: Every talkgroup patched with this one, its own included (only when patched).

freqList.description: The frequencies it was on (one here): `time` Unix s, `pos` / `len` s into the audio.

errorList.description: Voice-frame errors over the call (digital), by interval: `pos` / `len` s into the audio.

srcList.description: The radios that talked: `time` Unix s, `pos` s into the audio. `tag`: the unit's name (the unit names file or the alias heard, by the system's mode); `tag_ota`: the alias heard.

CallRecord.description: Trunk Recorder's call JSON: each call's .json file, and `record` in `concluded` and `hello.history`.

system.description: SystemStatus.index; conventionalSystem(k) for conventional system k's channels.

tone.description: Conventional FM: the CTCSS tone ("151.4 Hz") or DCS code ("D023N") heard.

patched.description: The talkgroups patched with this one during the call.

alsoOn.description: Multi-site: the other sites carrying this call (one copy is saved).

tone.description: FM: the CTCSS tone or DCS code it records, Trunk Recorder's form ("151.4", "D023N"); absent / "": any.

Channel.description: A conventional channel. `talkgroup` defaults to the frequency in kHz; `squelchDb` to the section's.

conventional.description: The conventional systems; the k-th's calls carry `system` conventionalSystem(k).

allowedOrigins.description: Web pages from other origins that may use the API ("http://host:port", "null" a file, "*" any).

interfaces.description: Interfaces of your own, served at /ui/<name>/ (docs/api).

home.description: What / shows: "" the built-in interface (always at /builtin/ too), else an interface's name.

plugins.description: The plugins, by id (desktop app). Their settings for each system are in the system.

shortName.description: Folder / record name of its calls.

name.description: What people call it; the short name is its folder.

squelchDb.description: Open threshold above the noise floor, dB (each channel may have its own).

channelFile.description: Desktop: a CSV the channels are read from ("" = the list here). Changed with the channelFile message.

channelFileStatus.description: How the channel file last read (from the recorder).

plugins.description: Plugins' settings for it (one more system to them), by plugin id.

recording.description: Its own recording rules; each left out is the Recording tab's.

Conventional.description: A conventional system (Trunk Recorder's conventional / conventionalP25 / conventionalDMR): energy-detected channels with their own short name, squelch, channel file, recording rules, unit names and upload settings. A frequency belongs to one system.

path.description: The folder: absolute, ~/…, or relative to the config file's folder.

CustomInterface.description: An interface of your own: a folder with an index.html, served as it is on disk at /ui/<name>/.

busy.description: Why it can't be opened now (another program has it); absent / null = free.

variant.description: "DMR Capacity Plus" | "DMR Capacity Max" | "DMR Connect Plus" | "DMR Tier III" | null (not known yet).

rest.description: Capacity Plus: the rest channel's logical slot number, and its frequency once known.

channels.description: Logical channel → frequency: from the config, or learned from the air.

carriers.description: Every watched frequency: sending control blocks, and each slot's call now.

DriverState.description: An optional driver (desktop app) and what it found; `devices` null = not searched.

recording.description: Recorders in use (shared by every system).

units.description: Each system's radios' talker aliases, as saved: short name → unitTagsOTA CSV.

heard.description: The codes each conventional frequency (Hz, as a string) carried, as saved.

encoderFound.description: The M4A encoder found for the config's choice (null: none).

source.description: "registry": just fetched; "saved": fetched before (the registry couldn't be reached); "built-in": this version's copy.

fetched.description: When it was fetched, Unix seconds.

problem.description: Why the registry couldn't be reached.

target.description: This computer's release target, e.g. universal-apple-darwin.

HeardCode.description: A code a conventional frequency carried (crates/trunk-app/src/heard.rs), in a row's Tone form ("" = none).

system.description: The system's short name, for its messages.

LogSettings.description: The log (desktop app), with Trunk Recorder's options (crates/trunk-app/src/config.rs LogSettings).

custom.description: A build of the user's own (not installed in the plugins folder).

unlistedFrom.description: The GitHub repository it was installed from, when that wasn't the registry (nobody reviewed it).

manifest.description: Null when it can't be asked (see `problem`).

PluginInfo.description: An installed plugin (or one the config names), and what it is. Whether it's on, and its settings, are in the config.

PluginManifest.description: What a plugin says it is (`<plugin> --describe`).

PluginRuntime.description: How a plugin is doing while recording.

required.description: Fields that have to be filled in (of an object).

x-required.description: This field has to be filled in (as the plugin marked it; SDK 0.1.0 leaves it on the field).

x-system.description: A system's short name: drawn as a menu of the systems.

PluginSchema.description: A plugin's settings, as JSON Schema — the subset the settings form draws (trunk-recorder-plugin's schema.rs).

path.description: Run this executable instead of the installed plugin (a build of the user's own).

PluginSetup.description: A plugin, as the config has it: on or off, and its settings for the whole recorder.

callTimeoutS.description: A call ends this long after its last grant or audio, s.

recordUnknown.description: Talkgroups not in the talkgroup file.

keepSilentCalls.description: Keep calls with no audio (encrypted, nothing decoded).

minCallS.description: Drop calls with less audio than this, s; 0 = keep all (Trunk Recorder's minDuration).

maxCallS.description: Save a call this long and carry on in a new one, s; 0 = no limit (maxDuration).

minTransmissionS.description: Leave out transmissions shorter than this, s; 0 = keep all (minTransmissionDuration).

normalizeAudio.description: Bring every call's speech to the same loudness.

digitalLevelDb.description: Then raise or lower digital / analog calls, dB (digitalLevels / analogLevels).

compressWav.description: Desktop: also keep an .m4a of every call (compressWav).

audioArchive.description: Desktop: keep the audio once every upload plugin has handled the call (audioArchive).

callLog.description: Desktop: keep the call's JSON then (callLog).

archiveFilesOnFailure.description: Desktop: when an upload failed, keep the files anyway (archiveFilesOnFailure).

filenameFormat.description: Where calls go under the recordings folder ("" = <short name>/<year>/<month>/<day>/).

captureFrames.description: Save each call's vocoder frames (<call>.frames.jsonl) for diagnosis.

dropDuplicateCalls.description: A call heard on several sites of one system: save the best copy only.

vocoder.description: IMBE vocoder for P25 Phase 1 voice.

m4a.description: M4A for the plugins that upload it, and for compressWav (desktop app).

recordUnknown.description: Talkgroups not in the talkgroup file.

minTransmissionS.description: Leave out transmissions shorter than this, s; 0 = keep all (minTransmissionDuration).

digitalLevelDb.description: Then raise or lower digital / analog calls, dB (digitalLevels / analogLevels).

compressWav.description: Desktop: also keep an .m4a of every call (compressWav).

audioArchive.description: Desktop: keep the audio once every upload plugin has handled the call (audioArchive).

callLog.description: Desktop: keep the call's JSON then (callLog).

archiveFilesOnFailure.description: Desktop: when an upload failed, keep the files anyway (archiveFilesOnFailure).

filenameFormat.description: Where calls go under the recordings folder ("" = <short name>/<year>/<month>/<day>/).

SiteIdentity.description: A P25 site's identity (NAC, WACN, System ID are hex on the air). Absent = unknown / any.

SmartnetBandplan.description: A SmartNet band plan, in Trunk Recorder's config names (Hz; offset a channel number).

SoapyModule.description: A SoapySDR module (one per device family): the drivers it registered, or why it didn't load.

SoapyState.description: SoapySDR and its modules; `modules` null = this SoapySDR (0.7) can't list them.

Source.description: A radio, or a capture to replay. Every kind may have `autoTune`: correct its channels for the frequency error measured on the control channels (Trunk Recorder's autoTune); the error is measured and shown either way.

errorPpm.description: Its frequency error as measured on the control channels, ppm (+: signals come in high); null until measured.

tunePpm.description: The correction autoTune applies now, ppm.

unavailable.description: Why this recorder can't install it (no build for this computer, a newer plugin API); null when it can.

StoreListing.description: A plugin in the registry (crates/trunk-pro/src/plugins/store.rs): one release of it, pinned.

SurveyBand.description: A band the survey can scan.

dmr.description: DMR: the trunking its control blocks are ("DMR Capacity Plus", …) and its colour code.

SurveyCandidate.description: A signal the scan found. `freqHz` as heard (uncorrected); `correctedHz` once the ppm is known.

advertisedHz.description: The frequency the control channel announces for itself.

smartnet.description: A SmartNet control channel: the band plan learned from where granted channels light up.

ppmApply.description: As the source takes it (an RTL-SDR: whole ppm).

SurveySuggestion.description: What to put in the config.

name.description: What people call it ("County Public Safety"); the short name is its folder.

type.description: "smartnet": a Motorola SmartNet / SmartZone control channel (voice P25 or analog FM). "dmr": a trunked DMR site (Capacity Plus, Capacity Max, Connect Plus, Tier III); every control channel and `channels` frequency is watched.

lcnTable.description: DMR: logical channel number → frequency, Hz (Trunk Recorder's lcnTable); the rest is learned.

channels.description: DMR: voice frequencies to watch besides the control channels.

defaultMode.description: SmartNet: the voice of a talkgroup never heard granted.

expect.description: Only follow a control channel with this identity (e.g. this site, not a neighbour).

voiceChannels.description: Voice channels the survey heard (for placing sources).

recording.description: Its own recording rules; each left out is the Recording tab's.

unitNames.description: Names for its radios (Trunk Recorder's unitTagsFile and unitTagsMode).

siteGroup.description: Multi-site: sites with one group are one system (a call on several is saved once). Absent: grouped by what the control channels say (P25 WACN + System ID, SmartNet System ID).

plugins.description: Plugins' settings for this system, by plugin id (each plugin's `system_config` schema).

mismatch.description: The control channel is another system's / site's: why (its grants are not followed).

adjacent.description: Neighbouring sites its control channel announces.

patches.description: Patches standing now: the supergroup, and the talkgroups patched into it.

siteGroup.description: Multi-site: the system it is a site of ("p25:bee00.1a2", "group:<name>"), once known.

SystemStatus.description: One running system (site). `index` is what calls and audio carry as `system`.

TalkgroupName.description: A talkgroup and its alpha tag from the system's talkgroup file ("" when not in it).

UnitNames.description: Names for a system's radios: Trunk Recorder's unitTagsFile, kept as text (headerless `unit,name`; a unit between slashes is a regular expression, `/^1(\d{3})$/,Engine $1`), and unitTagsMode: "user" (these first, then the aliases heard; the default), "ota" (the aliases first), "user_only", "none".
